versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "GitHub Interaction Developer Helper" skill.
- Provides workflows for safe inspection and automation of GitHub issues, pull requests, reviews, and CI.
- Ensures contributor intent is preserved and avoids accidental destructive changes.
- Outputs include triage summaries, safe command/API call suggestions, scoped patch plans, and verification checklists.
- Details explicit validation steps and triggers for various GitHub-related automation needs.
